| Parasite | 2020 (92nd) | $262.7 million |
| Green Book | 2019 (91st) | $321.8 million |

**Total Box Office Revenue: $767.4 million**

This represents the combined worldwide box office gross for all five films that won the Academy Award for Best Picture in the most recent five ceremonies.
